title: VendorUrl Device Identification Request (client_to_server)
purpose: Valid request centered on VendorUrl to exercise initial parser entry points for Device Identification objects
expected_behavior: Server processes function code 0x2B with MEI type 0x0E and object list containing VendorUrl (object id 0x03) and returns a response with the Vendor URL string if successful
constraints_preserved: MBAP length consistent with total message
function code 0x2B for Encapsulated Interface Transport
issue_safety_notes: Issue 279 loopback connection timeout on repeated writes does not apply to single-read Device Identification requests; no stateful write sequences included
